name: interpersonal-communication
description: Interpersonal communication theory and practice for one-on-one and small group interaction. Covers communication models (linear, transactional, constructivist), self-disclosure and Johari Window, relational dialectics, communication climate, supportive versus defensive communication, feedback models, and adapting style across relationships and contexts. Use when analyzing communication dynamics, improving relationships, giving feedback, or understanding communication breakdowns between individuals.
